rule: Thumbnail size resolution must respect the sizeRounding argument and otherwise use the default (UP); code must not hard-code NEAREST or its own rounding.
naive: Resolver ignores the sizeRounding argument and hard-codes ThumbnailSizeRounding.NEAREST.
variant_note: In saleor/graphql/product/types/products.py, Product.resolve_thumbnail (the first-media thumbnail of a product) now ignores the sizeRounding argument (taken by **_kwargs) and hard-codes ThumbnailSizeRounding.NEAREST.
